items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-08-29
items.q: when, uh, when big time Kutchin, whispering boots, and Axe Handle Sam, and all those guys were living.

ctx.x: Don't worry. That was Fanny Dixon who, uh, came from out front of town. I never knew anything about her people, but, uh, she was a big time named type of prostitute, who used to work the streets. Now, I think she had a pimp once or twice, but somehow or another she got rid of the pimp, and she started working for herself. Uh, but all in all, like I said, those days are gone. Uh, and the houses of prostitution that we had up and down Rampart Street, up and down Dryad Street, and what we had uptown, uh, when, uh,…
